meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 只在处理 Git 提交、历史改写或历史调查时介入。它会先判断意图、查看仓库现状，再按规则拆分提交或查询历史，最后给出证据和未提交文件。
howto.when: 当任务需要 Git 提交或历史调查（如 rebase、blame、bisect 等）时触发；普通代码编辑不触发，除非明确要求做 Git 操作。

say.text: 帮我把刚才改动的文件按功能拆成两个提交。
say.note: 会把改动按功能分成两组，分别提交。

say.text: 查一下这个文件中第10到20行是谁最后改的。
say.note: 会运行 git blame 并标明行号和作者。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个。
say.note: 会进行交互式 rebase，并先请求确认。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude only acts for Git commits, history rewrites, or history queries. It checks intent and repo state first, then splits changes into commits or investigates history, and reports evidence plus uncommitted files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a Git commit or history investigation, such as rebase, blame, bisect, etc. Does not trigger for ordinary code edits unless the user explicitly asks for Git work.

say_en.text: Commit the recent changes as two commits by feature.
say_en.note: Claude splits the changes into two groups and commits each.

say_en.text: Who last changed lines 10-20 in this file?
say_en.note: Runs git blame and marks the line and author.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Performs an interactive rebase and asks for confirmation first.
